snippet.title: Exit Control - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
You woke up on your couch, but nothing is right. The office is silent. The lights are off. Hallways stretch farther than they used to. The exit feels impossibly far away.

🔦 Peek inside Exit Control's :

Explore a deserted two-floor office building with more than meets the eye

Search for keys, tools & clues while the tension mounts

Survive an unnerving atmosphere—constant whispers of something being wrong

Minimal HUD keeps you immersed in your surroundings

🏃‍♂️ Your tools for survival: move, crouch, run, interact—and above all, keep your wits about you.

📅 Now available on Windows via itch.io – grab it now : will you make it outside… or stay trapped forever?

📌 Get Exit Control on our Itch.Io
📌 Follow DarkShift Interactive for updates, behind-scenes, and more horror-fuelled stories
